business_problem: “Because of the regulation, the system is super slow and very expensive to operate,” explains Faruk Capan, EVERSANA’s Chief Innovation Officer. “We have to be very careful with the FDA, everything needs to be double checked.
solution_summary: Using Gemini platform , the team was able to build a taskforce of discrete, highly trained agents that function as expert teams. Powered by Google’s validated, compliant and powerful AI—including models like Gemini Veo , and Imagen —these agents work together simultaneously across strategy, omnichannel planning, and content creation. Gemini platform’s deep integration with BigQuery also ensures data privacy, enabling EVERSANA to ground agents in real-time business context while keeping client information within a secure corporate infrastructure and never using it for training or advertising. “We partner with Google Cloud because our clients need more than AI Innovation. They need accuracy, reliability, and security " Capan explains.
